en: The image shows both sides of an old postcard. The front features a sepia-tone photograph of a grand city square with large ornate buildings, a prominent fountain in the center, walkways, benches, and trees. At the bottom, the text reads 'Vängåfvan och Stora Torget', indicating the square and fountain. There's also handwriting and a printed publisher's note from 'W. Ahlströms Bokhandel, Sundsvall.' The backside displays sections for address details, written in Swedish, and addressed to an individual in Sweden.
